headline: Sammaan Capital Limited: Timely Interest Payment Certification on Listed Debentures
sum: Sammaan Capital Limited certified timely payment of interest on its listed Secured and Unsecured Redeemable Non-Convertible Debentures under SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulation 57, confirming compliance with debt service obligations.
detail: Sammaan Capital Limited, a non-banking financial company, issued both Secured and Unsecured Redeemable Non-Convertible Debentures via public issue and listed them on stock exchanges. On 23 June 2026, the company certified to the NSE that it had made timely payment of all accrued interest on these debentures in full compliance with SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015. This is a routine mandatory disclosure under Regulation 57, triggered after each interest payment date, to certify absence of default or payment delay.
